name: Qift

queries.query: site:gov.eg Qift cadastral map land registry Egypt official; Egyptian Survey Authority Qena Qift digital maps
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) service catalogue, its digital-map purchase/request page, the ESA directorate map locating Qena, and an official Egyptian government gazette record naming Qift local administration/state-property management. The ESA pages describe digital maps and survey certificates but do not expose an anonymous parcel feature service.

queries.result: Arabic first-party discovery confirmed ESA services for paper, digital and historical maps, coordinate certificates, boundary separation and land-allocation changes. The official ESA material identifies the Qena Survey Directorate and an official gazette scan identifies Qift city administration/state-property management, but no public parcel polygon or safe native parcel identifier was exposed.

officialSources.observation: Current ESA service catalogue lists paper and digital maps, coordinate certificates, topographic maps, land-allocation changes and boundary-separation services.

Current ESA digital-map page says customers request a location, scale and layers, choose formats such as GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG/orthophoto, and receive a quotation and delivery; listed scales include 1:50000, 1:2500 and 1:5000. This is a request/purchase workflow, not an anonymous parcel API.
Current ESA directorate map includes Qena Governorate and links to a Qena map image; it does not expose parcel vectors.

Official State Information Service gazette scan names Qena Governorate, Qift City/Centre Presidency and Qift state-property administration in a land sketch notice; the scan is documentary evidence, not machine-readable parcel geometry.
